country.evidence_quote: Since 1924, we have been North Carolina family owned and operated. We provide affordable, high-quality janitorial, school & office products to a broad customer base throughout the United States. Our continued growth is a direct result of loyal customers, dedicated employees, excellent suppliers and a management team that puts customers first.

contact.evidence_quote: In 2012, the company transitioned into it’s fourth generation of family leadership as Mercer Stanfield, son-in-law of Jim Brame Jr., took the helm as President and COO. Mercer’s industry knowledge and experience gained through working in various departments of the company provided him unique insight into the many challenges facing both the industry at large and especially family legacy businesses.
